title: shorea affinis
intro: Shorea affinis, commonly known as Bintangor, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Shorea affinis are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of Shorea affinis include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
